propositions: The single-pass review demo engine, parity harness, prompt, and eval spec must be deleted while ensuring code_quality.md is marked as default and index.json is regenerated.
Finished-cutover scaffolding including shadow comparators, spot-eval harness, and private re-exports per ADR 0111 must be removed from all importers.
Severity-driven gate policy must be eliminated, REBAR_VERIFY_PREFETCH removed with prefetch always enabled, and legacy overlay activate list form deprecated with warning.
Five confirmed-dead attestation helpers must be removed, the duplicated unresolvable-ref message single-sourced, and plan-review status surface schema-validated.
All client-facing changes must include release-notes entries, and all references to ticket-quality/ticket_quality must be removed from src, docs, and tests directories.
